cohort: The study included 42 patients (31 females and 11 males) diagnosed with congenital encephalocele managed at a tertiary hospital in Southwest Nigeria between July 2000 and December 2023.
finding: Early surgery for congenital encephaloceles can be performed with a favourable outcome, with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leak being the most common postoperative complication, particularly in the sincipital group.
